units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:5">Targ. Prov. XXIII, 5</cite> <he>אין תְּצַד וכ׳</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>תצר</he>) if thou turnest thy eye (h. text <he>התעיף</he>, v. Pesh. a. l.).—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 16:24">Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 24</cite> (cmp.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 99a">B. Bath. 99ᵃ</cite>, quot. in <cite ref="R00083">preced.</cite>).—

<cite ref="Shabbat 102b:5">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>תתאה בעי צַדּוּדֵי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>תתא</he>) to place the lowest stone it is necessary to make room for it in the ground and surround it with earth (v. <cite ref="R00083">preced.</cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 99a:7">B. Bath. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>דמְצַדְּדֵי אצדודי</he> they (the Cherubim) were turned sideways (so as to face both the house and each other).
